about: Modwerk source-only cc-remap package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/cc-remap.

mods.title: CC Remap
mods.summary: Choose which incoming CC moves each of a MIDI track’s eight CC VAL knobs, so a controller with fixed CC numbers can play them.
mods.description: Press AMP again on a MIDI track’s AMP page for CC Receive, where knobs A–H set the incoming CC for VAL1–VAL8 on the track’s own channel. Every slot starts at the stock 70–77; the tables are saved on the +Drive for the whole unit.
mods.author: draadpiraat
mods.on_unit: Tested on a Digitakt I by the author, alone and with CC Assignment Names (0.2.0); 0.1.0 also with FX Track.
